LocalScribe

LocalScribe releases, built by GitHub Actions from https://github.com/TheScriptingGuy/localscribe and signed with the developer's release key.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://thescriptingguy.github.io/localscribe/repo
